en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large, wooden, oval or polygonal building with high arched windows and a hipped roof with an additional upper roofed structure. Several people in late‑19th‑century style clothing (long dresses, coats, hats) stand or walk in front of the building on an unpaved street. There is a single streetlamp near the entrance. The image is centered on a plain white card with wide margins and no visible caption or back text.
